observation: Two buffer/format gaps against the reference. (1) The hero canvases measure CSS 1376x772 with buffer 2752x1544 on a devicePixelRatio-1.5 screen, i.e. the reference pins a 2x drawing buffer; the clone followed the device and got 2064x1158. (2) The spine DataTexture measures magFilter/minFilter NearestFilter and wrapT ClampToEdgeWrapping while the port set LinearFilter on both axes and RepeatWrapping on T; the reference source writes e.wrapY = C, a no-op because three names the property wrapT.
resolution: WebGLHost gained fixedPixelRatio (hero passes 2); makeSpineTexture now uses NearestFilter + ClampToEdgeWrapping. Both are exactness rather than visible fixes: sampling lands on texel centres, so filtering never blends between the four rows.

observation: Found ONLY by pixels. The fixed Join button had a DOM rect matching the reference to 1px (1150,677,207,76 vs [1150,676,207,76]) and was hit-testable at its centre, yet the reference screenshot shows a solid black block there (box mean rgb(8,6,6), 96.4% dark) while the clone showed flat page orange (box mean rgb(241,120,57), 1.0% dark). Every previous gate measured geometry and so passed it. Root cause: the component rendered `class="btn btn--start fixed-sign-up-button__btn"`, but the live reference element is `btn btn--start btn--primary btn--full btn--accent btn--large fixed-sign-up-button__btn`. `.btn` is `background-color: transparent` in the reference - ALL button paint lives on `.btn:after { position:absolute; inset:0; background: var(--btn-background, transparent) }`, and `--btn-background: #000` / `--btn-text: #fff` are supplied only by `.btn--primary` via `--t-button_primary_background: var(--c-black)`. Without that modifier the button had black text on nothing, and an earlier revision had papered over the resulting 38px collapse with a hardcoded `height: var(--sign-up-height)`.
nextAction: None. Re-captured after the fix: box mean rgb(5,5,5), 97.3% dark vs the reference 96.4%. The hardcoded height was removed - btn--large now supplies --btn-height: calc(var(--scale-px)*80) = 76.44px, matching the measured 76.4375px.
resolution: Modifier classes added and the height workaround deleted. Also transcribed the real accessible label onto the anchor: "Join 4,000+ artists and curators across 100+ countries on FOLLOW.ART for portfolio, contacts, booking, and direct financial support in one place" (measured from .fixed-sign-up-button .sr-only and its aria-label).
